title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: Hold for a licensing-price correction: the briefing says the licensing page gives no price for Teams Rooms Basic, but that page explicitly says Basic is free. Narrow the sentence to Teams Rooms Pro, for which the cited page gives no price. The rollout, prerequisites and documented controls otherwise match the supplied records and Microsoft Learn.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn labels in-person note-taking as preview, unlike the General Availability roadmap and notice.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.claim: The Windows release notes contain an AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator entry.
claims.quote: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator

claims.claim: That release-note entry is marked as available only with Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Features with the ![](../media/mtr-pro-icon.png) icon are available only with Teams Rooms Pro license.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature is available automatically once prerequisites are met, without additional admin enablement.
claims.quote: The feature is available automatically once licensing and prerequisite configurations are met.- No additional admin enablement is required beyond existing settings.

claims.claim: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed into summaries, decisions and action items.
claims.quote: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate AI-powered meeting notes, including summaries, decisions, and action items.

claims.claim: Learn says in-room notes are stored as a Loop file in tenant-owned SharePoint Embedded.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant

claims.claim: Learn treats these notes as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.claim: The Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say notes do not inherit the meeting sensitivity label.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.

claims.claim: The Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say Prevent copy and paste is not applied to AI notes.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.claim: The Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say watermarks are not applied to AI notes.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.claim: The Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say notes are not automatically collected as eDiscovery cloud attachments.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited meetings limitations do not explicitly identify in-person room notes as their scope.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person sensitivity eDiscovery; read facilitator-teams, rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and purview/ai-teams-facilitator on Learn. The limitations and Purview guidance discuss meetings without explicitly identifying unscheduled in-person room notes.

claims.claim: Only participants who add their names at the beginning and have enrolled profiles are identified and attributed.
claims.quote: Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.claim: The Facilitator app must be enabled for the room resource account.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: If app availability is scoped to People and Groups, it must include the room resource account.
claims.quote: If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.claim: Muting the room microphone prevents Facilitator or transcription capturing content.
claims.quote: You can mute the microphone in the room to ensure Facilitator or transcription doesn't capture any content.

claims.claim: Show Take notes button on the home screen is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn warns that the experience and licensing model may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.claim: The in-person setup steps on the Teams Rooms page list no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Searched: the Set up Facilitator for AI-generated notes section of rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms on Learn for Copilot licensing. Its in-person prerequisite names Teams Rooms Pro; the Copilot licence statement belongs to the separate scheduled-meetings section.

claims.claim: The in-person setup steps on the Teams Rooms page name no meter.
claims.quote: Searched: rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms on Learn, Set up Facilitator for AI-generated notes, for a meter or consumption charge. Read all four setup steps and the licensing note; they name no meter.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences page compares what Basic and Pro include.
claims.quote: The following tables compare the Teams Rooms Basic and Teams Rooms Pro licenses and show what features are available with each.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences page states no price for Teams Rooms Basic.
claims.quote: You need to add and assign a free Teams Rooms Basic license for each device via the Microsoft 365 admin center. You need to provide payment details, although no charge will be made for Teams Rooms Basic licenses.
claims.fix: Replace 'the Teams Rooms licences page lists what Teams Rooms Basic and Pro include and states no price for either' with 'the Teams Rooms licences page lists what Teams Rooms Basic and Pro include and states no price for Teams Rooms Pro'. The cited page explicitly describes Basic as free.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Price; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Teams Rooms licences page states no price for Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Searched: rooms/rooms-licensing on Learn for price, cost, free and charge while reading the complete page. It describes Pro features and purchase channels but gives no Pro price; its free/no-charge statements refer to Basic.

claims.claim: The Loop admin policy page says Loop file storage, including SharePoint Embedded, counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by .loop files (earlier releases created .fluid files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to ensure Facilitator is enabled in the tenant.
claims.quote: Ensure Facilitator is enabled in your tenant.

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to verify IsLoopEnabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to verify IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to ensure transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.
claims.quote: Ensure meeting transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.

claims.claim: The Take notes control is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API for the Pro Management portal Take notes setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Take notes API PowerShell. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and rooms/pro-portal-settings on Learn; searched results cover portal configuration but provide no API or command for this setting.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the selected meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The in-person setup points to general meeting transcription guidance without specifying which meeting policy the room account uses.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in-person room meeting policy. Read rooms/facilitator-teams-rooms and meeting-transcription-captions on Learn; the setup links general transcription guidance without specifying policy selection for unscheduled room notes.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the two Teams-specific Loop SharePoint properties.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center. Read loop-components-configuration on Learn: these Teams properties use SharePoint PowerShell; its admin-center UI controls Loop workspaces, not these properties.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true; Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables the two documented Teams Loop properties.
claims.quote: Enable Loop workspaces creation and Loop component creation and integration everywhere ... [Teams-only] Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true, Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true

claims.claim: The Teams Loop properties apply tenant-wide rather than per user.
claims.quote: It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property does not apply to Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: The Loop page directs administrators to Cloud Policy for the Teams New Calendar case.
claims.quote: Loop components in Outlook, OneNote, Whiteboard, Teams New Calendar | Cloud Policy | Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop

claims.claim: The Facilitator app is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Blocking all apps for the organisation also blocks Facilitator.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The linked Facilitator page documents Teams admin center steps to allow or block the app.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: The Facilitator page says Loop file generation was discontinued on 31 July 2026.
claims.quote: As part of this change, Loop file generation has been discontinued as of July 31, 2026. Facilitator live notes remain unaffected.

claims.claim: The Facilitator page attributes that discontinuation to a migration to a new document-generation back end.
claims.quote: We have migrated to a new back-end system to improve document generation. As part of this change, Loop file generation has been discontinued as of July 31, 2026.
